_comment: DRAFT metadata for qwenpaw-infra-email. NOT DEPLOYED — the account has zero zones, so no Email Routing rule can point at this Worker yet. Deploy only after a domain is added as a zone. Secrets QWENPAW_USER / QWENPAW_PASS must be set with `wrangler secret put` (or the API secrets endpoint) — never in this file. NOTE: plain-text vars MUST be plain_text bindings — a top-level "vars" object is silently dropped by the upload API (learned deploying qwenpaw-infra-activity). After upload, enable the workers.dev route with POST /workers/scripts/qwenpaw-infra-email/subdomain {"enabled": true} (API tokens cannot use PUT here).
